title: Hosted API telemetry-led metering probe: shadow billing for directional IO and streaming
creator: Marcus Li
description: Run a telemetry-driven pricing probe that collects directional input/output token distributions and streaming handshake/idle patterns to evaluate a shadow billing model. The goal is to compare revenue and customer cost sensitivity across three candidate metering rules (symmetric per-token, input-weighted, and streaming-minimum-aware) without changing live invoices. This will inform an eventual proposal for asymmetric IO rates + streaming minima for hosted API enterprise pricing.
acceptance_criteria: Instrumentation in production that records per-request: direction (ingress/egress), streaming flag with handshake/idle times, model_id, route_tag, and customer_tier without storing prompt content
Shadow billing pipeline produces daily cohort-level reports (per-customer hashed id) comparing current billing to candidate model outputs for the last 30 days
Dashboard visualizations for revenue delta, median customer delta, and percentage of customers crossing >10% bill change
Legal sign-off on telemetry scope and confirm we can collect hashed identifiers and token counts per enterprise contract
Run completed with sample size sufficient for statistical significance (target 95% CI) for top 50 customers by spend
success_metrics: Identify whether any candidate increases cost for >10% of top-50 customers (failure if true)
Estimated platform revenue delta (monthly) within +/- 8% under candidate 2 (input-weighted)
Median per-customer bill change under candidate 3 (streaming-min-aware) less than 3% for non-streaming-heavy customers
Telemetry overhead on serving runtime < 2% P50 latency impact
Stakeholder alignment (PM, RevOps, Legal, Eng) to move one candidate to a customer-facing pilot
plan: Week 1: Design telemetry schema and obtain Legal & Security confirmation on allowed telemetry for enterprise customers (SQ dependencies)
Week 1: Engineering spike to measure overhead of counting directional tokens and streaming handshake timing in runtime; produce performance microbenchmarks
Week 2: Build shadow-billing pipeline in analytics: ingest telemetry, apply billing rules, and output per-customer deltas; publish initial dashboards
Week 3: Run 14-day silent shadow across all hosted customers, with opt-out for customers flagged in contracts that disallow usage telemetry
Week 4: Analyze cohorts, iterate on candidate weights, and draft recommended pricing artifacts for RevOps and Sales playbook
Post-probe: Present findings at Pricing Review; if approved, prepare canary pilot with billing opt-in for 10 enterprise customers
